newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria jails Turk for spying on border security.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria jails Turk for spying on border security.

text.p: A court in Bulgaria's second city of Plovdiv has sentenced Turkish citizen Kamuran Dogu to 10 years in prison for spying, the official news agency BTA said on Wednesday.
"Dogu was sentenced to 10 years in a maximum-security prison...after a two-month closed door trial," said the agency.
Dogu registered a trade firm in Plovdiv in 1992, which authorities said was used as a cover for his activities. BTA said he was accused of collecting information on border security.

Bulgaria was ruled for hundreds of years by the Turkish Ottoman Empire until the late 19th century and relations have often been tense since. Bulgarian and Turkish officials were not immediately available for comment on the case.
